_comment: One entry per photo shipped. Filled by whoever adds the photo. Required for every build (docs/06). Alt text here is byte-identical to the alt text the page renders. Two batches: the first six were supplied by the chapter e-board on 2026-08-12 and their provenance is carried across from src/data/landing.ts; the twenty added on 2026-09-06 came from a supply of sixty masters on 2026-09-05, triaged in assets-src/photo-triage.md. Photographs marked "Stacked Up Summit" are professional work credited to Chloe Jackman Photography in the master filenames, held back until the chapter confirmed on 2026-09-06 that they had been legally downloaded and could be published here. Photographs marked "board photoshoot at Northrop" are a styled editorial shoot of two to three board members at Northrop Auditorium, NOT snapshots of a meeting; see notAudited below, because the section they mostly fill is headlined "This is what a Tuesday looks like".

notAudited: public/images/colorstack-umn-logo.png, summit-group-800.webp and summit-group-1600.webp were copied across with the rest of the existing set but nothing on the landing page references them.

The eleven "board photoshoot at Northrop" photographs are a styled editorial shoot, not meeting-night candids. They currently supply most of the In the Room gallery, whose headline is "This is what a Tuesday looks like." That is a stretch and the e-board should either bless it or supply real meeting photographs with broader member representation. Raised as open question 3 in assets-src/photo-triage.md.

Individuals are named in several master filenames in assets-src/photos/UMNSTACKEDUP/. No name appears in any alt text or in this file, but these are prominent, repeated, close-up appearances of a small number of people and the chapter should be sure each of them agreed to be on the public site.
